author: /root/hair_ops
scope: Five previously frozen independent reviews are preserved as distinct records. Source originals were copied exactly to a separate local-only stage; this packet contains privacy-screened exact copies or reconstructed bytes, never private original archives. Historical reviewers, revisions, prior observations and later observations remain separate.
original_manifests: Original review MANIFEST files are retained as historical byte-identical records; they describe the frozen originals. In CP38, privacy-reconstructed public files deliberately do not have those original hashes. The root publication manifest and identity mapping govern this additive packet.
dependency_qualification: The CP37 checked-stage snapshot and other original/private external inputs are not included. A snapshot manifest hash and independent count/hash verification are recorded; a reader needs the exact separately retained external inputs and the unredacted local originals to replay historical verifiers. Redacted scripts are preserved as provenance text; they are not represented as executable or self-contained.
privacy_qualification: All regular text and decoded gzip payloads in both 186-entry reconstructed CP7 tar archives were scanned. Genuine local paths are replaced in the public CP38 records, with consistent placeholders; static slash-prose fragments, source regex literals, relative references and canonical historical agent identifiers were not mistaken for personal paths. Contextual absolute path, Windows path, escaped-newline and credential-pattern scanning is bounded and cannot prove all sensitive information absent.
historical_qualification: The CP7 initial review evaluates one earlier reconstructed stage. The later successor review separately evaluates its successor; they are distinct artifacts with distinct hashes. Neither is the private original archive or the previously damaged opaque public archive. No source read, product validation or checkpoint-3821 authority is inferred.
